svg.text: eight A-side loads tile a 256 x 64 fp16 block
Each load covers 32 rows: 8 rows per wave,
one 8-row stripe per wave in the workgroup.
load 0 as one wave sees it: 8 lanes per row
byte offset within the row — each cell is one lane's 16 B (global_load_dwordx4), numbered by lane id
Lane ids run along the row, so the instruction touches 8 cache lines and uses all 128 B of each.
Making the 64 lanes fully linear instead (our experiment) packs the same 8 lines into one 1 KB run.
lane index walks the row stride instead
each row is one 128 B cache line; white cells are fetched but unused
Every lane opens a new cache line:
used in each — 8× the line traffic
for the same 1 KB of useful data.
